about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Purification of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: We beseech You, O Lord our God, that the sacrament You have given as the bulwark of our atonement may be made a saving remedy for us in this life and in the life to come. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
